headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Chip Rout Deepens as Anthropic's Flat Debut Fails to Revive AI Trade. The big swing: chip and AI stocks rallied early, then turned around after 9:57 AM and are now lower on the day — 24/7 Wall St. points to “Chip Stocks Just Had a Reversal Last Seen in March 2020”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip and AI stocks gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Down 2.4% at 9:57 AM, now -7.5%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom. In the news: “Chip Stocks Just Had a Reversal Last Seen in March 2020” (24/7 Wall St.).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 11:47 AM, high at 10:00 AM; -1.4% since the open.

themes.headline: Chip Rout Deepens as Anthropic's Flat Debut Fails to Revive AI Trade
